## What

`python/openbrain/tests/test_receipts_gate_crosslang.py::test_python_capture_receipt_clears_the_gates_capture_block` fails on the untouched base tree and on the primary checkout. It executes the **out-of-repo** `/Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/_ob/scripts/context-budget-gate.ts`, whose behavior has drifted from what the test pins. CI never sees the failure because the `_ob` file is absent on runners, so the test skips — CI stays green while every local push is blocked by pre-push.

State per LAW 0: RUNNING (reproduced by the #512 lane, 2026-08-09, on base `4368e44`-era tree and primary checkout).

## Why it matters

- A test whose CI verdict and local verdict permanently disagree trains people to bypass it — the #512 lane had to use the test's own documented `OPENBRAIN_CONTEXT_BUDGET_GATE` override to push (no `--no-verify`).
- Silent-skip-in-CI + fail-locally is the exact fail-open shape B7/#679 is about, on the test side.

## Done-means

The cross-language receipt test either (a) pins a gate version/contract it vendors or resolves hermetically, or (b) skips loudly with a reason naming the missing/drifted dependency in BOTH environments — never green-in-CI/red-locally for the same tree. Regression check proves the old split verdict is impossible.

Found by the #512 lane (PR #703); reported not fixed, per lane scope.

Part of the test/CI hygiene cluster (#683 adjacent).
